en.headline: Underground cable fault leaves 2,400 Yuen Long households without power
en.dek: CLP Power said a fault at about 4.22am affected Shui Pin Wai Estate and nearby areas; engineers aimed to restore supply by 10am using temporary generators and cables.
body: An underground cable fault in Yuen Long left about 2,400 households without electricity in the early hours of Tuesday, CLP Power said.

The company reported that the fault occurred at approximately 4.22am and affected Shui Pin Wai Estate and surrounding customers. Most blocks in the estate lost power, with only one building remaining supplied. Residents reported waking in extreme heat without air-conditioning or lifts.

CLP engineers were deploying temporary generators and laying temporary cables, with restoration targeted for around 10am. Community support teams provided portable batteries to care homes and coordinated with the district office and local councillors.

zh.headline: 元朗地底電纜故障 水邊圍邨約2400戶停電
zh.dek: 中電指凌晨約4時22分發生故障，影響水邊圍邨及附近用戶，工程人員調動臨時發電機及電纜搶修，料上午10時復電。
body: 中電表示，今日凌晨約4時22分元朗區地底電纜發生故障，影響水邊圍邨及附近約2400名客戶的電力供應。
水邊圍邨七幢大廈中僅一幢有電，其餘全部停電。不少居民在酷熱天氣下熱醒，家中冷氣及升降機停用，有家長需抬嬰兒車落樓避暑。邨內全日制幼兒學校亦受影響，緊急借用鄰近校舍上課。
中電工程人員正全力搶修，包括調動臨時發電機及鋪設臨時電纜，預計上午10時完成。社區支援隊已到場為受影響院舍提供流動電池，並與民政事務處及區議員緊密溝通。
